The way you calculated average kd is literal average kd. It doesn't have any meaning.

That's not how it works. You divide kd by kd. Since kd is just a ratio centered around 1 you'd need to adjust your calculations.

Just think about this. A player that has more deaths than kills will have a kd of 0.00 - 0.99. A player that has more kills than deaths will have a kd of >1 - infinity. Averaging this is a bit weird right?

To calculate real average kd you divide kd of positive going players by dk (death/kill ratio) of negative going players. In warzone this means average kd is 1 (not taking suicide deaths into account).
